      let lastIndex = 0

                setSelectedGlossaryTerm(termData)

              <Info className='ml-0.5 h-3 w-3 opacity-60 group-hover:opacity-100' />

          )

          remainingText = remainingText.substring(index + term.length)

        }
      }

      // 残りのテキストを追加
      if (remainingText) {
        result.push(remainingText)
      }

  )
